searchText: I'm wondering if we should update the builder-specs getHeader responses with a separate status code if there's no header available (would also be used at the merge until after the agreed delay period) 🤔 Would be here: https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/blob/main/apis/builder/header.yaml#L43 Otherwise there'd just be error 400 in the spec. How about adding a "204 No Content" response for this? https://www.webfx.com/web-development/glossary/http-status-codes/what-is-a-204-status-code/ Second question: should we disable registerValidator signature verification in mev-boost and leave it up to the relays? https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost/issues/170 Flashbots will publish a **weekly mev-boost & ecosystem status update** going forward, with the first issue out today: https://flashbots.notion.site/mev-boost-Status-Update-June-17-24-2022-d149861bd6814d94b62cc99d0c806ede 🗞️🎉 (If there's topics, posts, shoutouts or other things you feel would be nice in the next issue, lmk ⭐)

Otherwise there'd just be error 400 in the spec. How about adding a "204 No Content" response for this?
